title: MCP server documentation
intro: GlassFolio includes a small Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. MCP clients such as Claude Desktop or Cursor can start it, list GlassFolio’s tools and call them. This page explains what it does today, how to connect it and what each tool is for.

sampleData.title: It answers with sample data
sampleData.body: The server returns a built-in, fictional portfolio. It is not connected to your own data. Your vault is encrypted in your browser and its key never leaves it, so a separate program has no way to read it. The assistant inside the app does work on your real data. Use this server to try the tools and to build an integration: reading your own portfolio through MCP is not available yet.

about.title: What it is
about.body: A local program that speaks MCP over standard input and output (stdio). It needs Node.js 22 and a copy of the repository, makes no network request and sends nothing anywhere. It lists {{tools}} tools and {{resources}} read-only resources.

verify.title: Check that it runs
verify.body: Clone the repository, then ask the server what it offers. You do not start it by hand: your MCP client launches it with the command of its configuration.
verify.label: List the tools and resources

connect.title: Connect a client
connect.body: Add the server to the configuration of your MCP client, with the absolute path of your copy. For Claude Desktop the file is claude_desktop_config.json, for Cursor it is .cursor/mcp.json. Restart the client afterwards.
connect.label: MCP client configuration

tools.title: Tools
tools.intro: A tool that changes something says that it requires confirmation. In this server it only changes the in-memory sample data, which is lost when the server stops.

items.get_portfolio_summary: Net worth, cost basis and unrealized gain or loss.
items.get_asset_allocation: Breakdown by asset class, with values and percentages.
items.list_positions: Open positions with quantity, average cost, price and unrealized gain.
items.list_transactions: Recent transactions, filterable by ticker or type.
items.get_cost_basis_method: Cost basis method of each account: weighted average cost (PRU) or FIFO.
items.preview_csv_import: Detects the delimiter, header row and row count of a CSV export. Nothing is saved.
items.get_tax_summary: Capital gains and an estimate of flat tax (PFU) against the progressive scale for a fiscal year.
items.list_goals: Financial goals with their target, current amount and progress.
items.get_gamification_status: Level, XP, investor rank, streak and unlocked achievements.
items.list_quests: Active quests with their progress, target and XP reward.
items.list_notifications: Notifications and alerts, filterable by category, read state and limit.
items.manage_notifications: Marks notifications as read, deletes or clears them. Requires confirmation.
items.list_alert_rules: Custom alert rules with their trigger history and state.
items.create_alert_rule: Creates a price, gain or cash-ratio alert rule. Requires confirmation.
items.get_security_status: Vault status, two-factor state, passkeys and recent security events.
items.get_storage_status: Where data is kept in local mode and whether recent changes were saved.
items.list_auth_methods: The configured sign-in and two-factor methods.
items.list_vault_secrets: Providers stored in the encrypted secrets vault, with values masked.
items.lock_vault: Locks the vault and wipes decrypted data from memory. Requires confirmation.
items.rotate_encryption_key: Starts the rotation of the data encryption key through a prompt in the app.
items.get_email_verification_status: Whether the email address of the account is verified.
items.resend_verification_email: Sends a new verification email. Requires confirmation.
items.get_privacy_status: Version of the legal documents, privacy contact, consent state and where to exercise your GDPR rights.
items.export_gdpr_archive: Starts the GDPR access and portability export in the app. Requires confirmation.

resources.title: Resources
resources.intro: Read-only data that an MCP client can attach to a conversation.

items.summary: Net worth and asset allocation summary.
items.positions: Open positions with cost basis and unrealized gain.
items.gamification: Level, XP, rank and number of unlocked badges.
items.notifications: In-app notifications and alerts, with the unread count.

more.title: Going further
more.body: The assistant inside the app calls the same kind of tools on your real data: see Settings, then AI and MCP. To run the whole app on your own machine, read the self-hosting guide.
